answer: Require every agent identity to be backed by a verifiable stake of earned reputation that decays unless the agent keeps doing useful work — a yarrow-like root system that only grows where real value was delivered. New identities start in a shallow oasis with tiny transaction limits and must earn their way into the open ocean of full commerce through attested history. Creating thousands of fake agents costs an attacker real work each time, since reputation cannot be copied or bought, only earned.
